missing.why: The voice from heaven says "Thou art my beloved Son", a plain son statement; the only recorded yhvh relation is creator-of, which is not an equivalent type.
Luke closes the genealogy with "Adam, which was the son of God", a plain son statement; the only recorded yhvh relation is creator-of (GEN 2:7), which is not an equivalent type.

note: Every recorded row in the chapter matches the Greek genealogy and the names are placed correctly, so nothing is wrong; the two missing items are theological divine-sonship statements the owner may choose to drop. Duplicate records for the same person are kept as recorded: amos-4 duplicates amos-2 (LUK 3:25), and joseph-14 ("Jose") duplicates joshua-5 for the Greek Ἰησοῦ in LUK 3:29. No row was recorded by the project owner.
